sections.changelog: 2.32.0: final post-import reconciliation scan (all 7 batches, 232 zero-practice-area posts cross-checked against raw source labels) found 11 more compound labels that map cleanly to an existing term. Added aliases; genuinely homeless niches (sports/aviation/military law, online gaming) left unmapped on purpose. 2.31.0: URGENT - bulk law-firm import published hundreds of records in one day, and publish-notify.php's owner-ordered per-publish email hook fired once per record (~637 emails), triggering a uPress account-wide mail rate-limit. Added a pause/resume toggle (POST justice-ops/v1/publish-notify-pause). 2.30.0: 4 compound practice-area labels didn't substring-match their obvious existing term. Added exact aliases.
